purpose: Determine the exact stock-flow structure required if RMD uses gross government debt-securities issuance, and separate the market-valued S13 F3 securities stock from the Maastricht gross-debt reference target.

source_discovery.source_start_context: CSEC methodology states availability from December 2020; exact series coverage must be retained by a source probe before promotion.
source_discovery.unresolved_materialisation_detail: Exact all-maturity/all-currency gross-issue, redemption, revaluation and other-change keys must be discovered and retained by a frozen CSEC source probe rather than inferred from key syntax.

stock_flow_identity.exact_csec_form: F3_stock[t] = F3_stock[t-1] + gross_issues[t] - redemptions[t] + revaluations[t] + other_changes_in_volume[t]
stock_flow_identity.implication: Gross issuance alone is not a stock update. A quantitative gross-issuance-to-stock implementation without redemptions and other flows is structurally incomplete.

csec_S13_F3_stock.exact_role: candidate observed stock-flow substate for securities issuance dynamics

blockers: government_debt_issuance has no single frozen semantic boundary across loops
gross issuance requires redemptions for a transaction-level net stock effect
market-valued F3 stocks additionally require revaluations and other changes in volume
the existing government_debt_stock reference target is Maastricht debt, not CSEC market-valued non-consolidated F3
a bridge from an F3 stock-flow substate to Maastricht AF2+AF3+AF4 debt has not been defined or validated

candidate_nodes.role: gross inflow into a market-valued S13 F3 securities substate
gross outflow from the market-valued S13 F3 securities substate

candidate_nodes.candidate_source: ECB CSEC other changes in volume

candidate_structural_refinement.future_bridge_requirement: Any future bridge must preserve AF2/AF3/AF4 scope, nominal/face valuation, consolidation and stock-flow-adjustment semantics; F3 market-value stock may not be substituted directly.

scientific_decision.next_step: Freeze and execute a CSEC Romania S13 F3 source-discovery/materialisation contract for gross issues, redemptions, net issues, stock, revaluations and other changes on one exact unit/currency/maturity boundary. Only after that source state exists should RMD preregister a topology refinement or an F3 stock-flow submodel.
